newsitem.title: UK: Gulf Canada has 40.97 pct stake in Clyde.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada has 40.97 pct stake in Clyde.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd said on Monday that by February 14 it either owned or had acceptances for around 40.97 percent of bid target Clyde Petroleum Plc.
Gulf's offer of 120 pence per share, valuing the company at 494 million pounds ($801 million), closes at 1300 GMT on February 18.
The Canadian oil group said in a statement that it had also received further acceptances which are not yet valid, representing 1.46 percent of all Clyde's ordinary share capital.
It has bought in total 29.99 percent of Clyde's issued ordinary share capital, the maximum permitted under the rules of the city code on take-overs and mergers.
One of Clyde's major shareholders, PDFM, has already sold its 14.9 percent stake to Gulf.
Schroders, Clyde's largest shareholder with a 19.5 percent stake, was last week reported to be sticking with Clyde, but a source at the fund manager declined to confirm this.
